method: Deterministic arithmetic on strictly parsed numbers: effective count = fabric count / threads per stitch (1 or 2); design width and height = stitch counts / effective count; cut size adds the margin to all four sides. Fabric count is interpreted as stitches per inch; centimetre entry and display are converted at 2.54 cm per inch. No allowance is made for centring, fraying, sewn finishes or fabric shrinkage.
